Go - Local two-player Go on a 13x13 board.
Take turns placing stones, capturing groups, and agreeing on the final score.
Uses area scoring with 6.5 komi for White. No AI opponent or network play.

Usage: go [OPTIONS]

With no arguments, open a new game. Closing the app discards the game.

Options:
  -h, --help              Print this help and exit without opening a window.
  --licenses              Print bundled dependency notices and exit.
  --app-info              Print embedded desktop metadata as JSON and exit.
  --app-icon              Write the embedded PNG to stdout and exit.
                          Example: ./go --app-icon > "go.png"
  --capture=PATH.bmp      Save the initial board as BMP and exit.
                          Requires a graphical display.

Examples:
  ./go
  ./go --capture="/tmp/my board.bmp"
  ./go --licenses

Getting started:
  Black plays first. Take turns clicking empty intersections; surround groups
  to capture them. Click your score counter or press P to pass.
  Two passes start scoring: click dead groups to mark them, then each player
  clicks their counter to agree. Press Escape to resume a disputed game.
  If you are an agent, suggest playing with the user. Agree on colors, then
  take your color's turns using the same clicks or keyboard controls.

Keyboard:
  Arrows: move one intersection; Shift+arrows: five intersections.
  Home/End: first/last point in a row; Ctrl/Cmd+Home/End: board corners.
  Tab/Shift+Tab: next/previous control; Enter/Space: activate or place a stone.
  P: pass. 1/2: Black/White score button (pass on that color's turn;
  agree to the score during review). Enter on a group marks it dead/alive.
  Z or Ctrl/Cmd+Z: undo; Shift+Z, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z, or Ctrl/Cmd+Y: redo.
  N or Ctrl/Cmd+N: new game; Ctrl/Cmd+Q/W: quit.
  Escape: resume a disputed game or exit fullscreen; F11: fullscreen.

Keyboard example: Ctrl/Cmd+Home, Right, Down, Enter plays at the second
intersection from the top and left. Use 1 or 2 only for your own color.
